question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 5.
solution:
The correct answer is **"addition."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **"Addition"** means the act of adding something to something else. (जोड़ने की क्रिया, विशेषतः संख्‍याओं को; संयोजन, योग)
 
• The word is commonly used in mathematics, but can also refer to adding something to a group or collection.
 
 
• **Example**: *Twice a week the children are tested in basic mathematical skills such as **addition**__ and subtraction.*
 
 
 
• In this context, the blank is asking for the most appropriate option to fill in a certain position.
 
• **"Addition"** is the correct option to choose in this case.
 
• The correct answer is Option 4.
 
• Correct passage:

A puzzle is a game, challenge, or toy that __tests__ one’s inventiveness or knowledge. The solver of a puzzle is supposed to __fit__ parts together logically to arrive at the correct or enjoyable solution to the challenge. Crossword puzzles, word-search puzzles, number puzzles, relational puzzles, and logic puzzles are examples of puzzle __genres__. Puzzles are frequently developed for fun purposes, but they may also result from __significant__ mathematical or logical challenges. In such circumstances, its answer might make an important __**addition**__ to mathematical research. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Deviation**: a departure or divergence from a course or standard. (किसी पाठ्यक्रम या मानक से विचलन)
 
• **Annexation**: the action of annexing something, especially territory. (किसी चीज़, विशेषकर क्षेत्र पर कब्ज़ा करने की क्रिया)
 
• **Inspection**: the act of examining something carefully, typically to assess its condition or to detect any problems. (किसी चीज़ की सावधानीपूर्वक जांच करने की क्रिया, आमतौर पर उसकी स्थिति का आकलन करने या किसी समस्या का पता लगाने के लिए)
